name: estudio
description: Estúdio criativo desktop: vídeo, imagem, 3D e efeitos, editáveis à mão ou pelo terminal com o Claude
author: Estúdio

scripts.instalador: npm run package && electron-builder --prepackaged out/pacote/Estudio-win32-x64 --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/copiar-instalador.mjs
scripts.mcp:build: esbuild mcp/nucleo.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist-mcp/nucleo.cjs --external:@remotion/bundler "--banner:js=var __estudio_url=require('node:url').pathToFileURL(__filename).href;" --define:import.meta.url=__estudio_url --log-level=warning && esbuild mcp/desktop.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist-mcp/desktop.cjs --external:@remotion/bundler "--banner:js=var __estudio_url=require('node:url').pathToFileURL(__filename).href;" --define:import.meta.url=__estudio_url --log-level=warning && esbuild mcp/ponte.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist-mcp/ponte.cjs --log-level=warning
scripts.nativos:mac: node scripts/nativos-alvo.mjs darwin arm64 && node scripts/nativos-alvo.mjs darwin x64
scripts.pacote:win: npm run mcp:build && electron-forge package --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.pacote:mac: npm run pacote:mac-arm64 && npm run pacote:mac-x64
scripts.pacote:mac-arm64: npm run mcp:build && electron-forge package --platform darwin --arch arm64 && electron-forge make --skip-package --platform darwin --arch arm64 --targets @electron-forge/maker-zip
scripts.pacote:mac-x64: npm run mcp:build && electron-forge package --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-forge make --skip-package --platform darwin --arch x64 --targets @electron-forge/maker-zip
scripts.instalador:win: npm run pacote:win && electron-builder --prepackaged out/pacote/Estudio-win32-x64 --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/copiar-instalador.mjs
